description: DBEngine.CompactDatabase(copy of r-sort-3-corpus-accdb, r-sort-3-compact-accdb-to-accdb-swedish.accdb, ";LANGID=0x041D;CP=1252;COUNTRY=0", 128): a fresh rebuild of every index by the engine with that sort-order locale and dbVersion. Whole-file image kept after compaction; DBEngine.Errors read. Then reopens the output read-only and reads Version and CollatingOrder, the T IX_K and IX_KD traversal, SQL ORDER BY K of T, and Seek "=" with a sample of every corpus group on IX_K. Asks whether the engine accepts this locale/version pair, which public order results, and what the rebuilt file looks like (other orders are scan and refusal controls).
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
